One-click painting review

See the painting. If pristine, click Approve → Queue 1. Everything else stays in Queue 2. No side panels, explanations or extra forms. Unavailable images cannot be approved until they display.

“Queue 1” here means you have approved the visible photograph for the publication pipeline. The original-file checksum, image rights and final crop still undergo automatic release checks. Approvals are saved in this browser and can be exported to update the canonical Git register; this standalone HTML cannot silently write to GitHub.
